title: ui: export sheet becomes a settings list

commit.merge_subject: merge: ui: export sheet becomes a settings list

description: The export sheet was a long stack of chip groups. It is now a Lightroom/Rush style list: a two-line summary from the ExportPlan, one 56dp row per setting (label, value, thin chevron), a collapsed Advanced section, and a sub-page that slides in for each choice with a one-line hint per option. Nothing was removed: every option, issue and explanation is kept (the old help texts head the sub-pages; the DNG/Linear/Photo descriptions live in the Format sub-page and under its row). Encoded clips hide the Format row and show Bit depth disabled with its reason. Issues are compact bands with their fix buttons; ERROR still locks Export. Selection is colour plus a thin check, never bold. Icons: Material Symbols Outlined weight 300 (info, warning, chevron_right, expand_more, arrow_back, check) vendored from Google Fonts, replacing the filled material-icons glyphs here. The sheet opens full height so
changed: ui: export sheet becomes a settings list
